fields.label: Words, phrases, or usernames (one per line)
fields.description: One entry per student. Each student gets their own link to type their word.

fields.label: Page title
fields.description: Heading shown at the top of the class links page.

fields.label: Instructions
fields.default: Find your name below and tap it to start typing practice.
fields.description: Instructions shown below the heading on the class links page.

fields.label: Show copy link buttons
fields.description: Show a copy button next to each student's link, for sharing links individually. Leave off if you're sharing this whole page with students directly.

fields.label: Letters per bar
fields.description: Number of correct letters/characters that fill one progress bar.

fields.label: Restore accuracy
fields.description: When checked, fixing a typo restores accuracy.

fields.label: Show virtual keyboard
fields.description: Show a virtual keyboard on the screen with the current key highlighted.

fields.label: Force players to correct typos
fields.description: When checked, players cannot continue to type after a typo until they fix it.

fields.label: Use sound
fields.description: Enable sound effects (click for each letter and ding for each filled item)

fields.label: Time limit (seconds)
fields.description: Game time limit in seconds. Set to 0 for unlimited time.

fields.label: Show timer
fields.description: Show the game timer on screen. When hidden, the game will still end at the time limit (unless set to unlimited).

fields.label: Show play again
fields.description: Show a 'Play again' button after the game ends.
